DRAFT — awaiting dual-control sign-off (Methodology Steward + Security Engineer)
per gaia/methodology/master-security.md § Gate 5. Until both approvals are
recorded below, treat this file as a proposal.
READ THIS BEFORE RELYING ON IT: the Gate 5 hook reads `allowed_mcps` and
nothing else. The `status` and `approvals` fields below are documentation, not
enforcement — the moment this file exists, MCP calls to the listed server are
permitted. That is a property of the hook, not of this file, and it is worth
knowing before anyone treats 'draft' as a safety margin.
Why it exists: the Lead Consultant app is the system of record for discovery
engagements, and the Merkle Discovery connector is the only way to read one
from a Claude session. Without a declared scope the regime is fail-closed, so
every question about a live engagement can only be answered from reproductions.
Scope is one server and read-only intent. The connector also exposes write
tools (record_answers, save_closing_document, save_approach, mark_questions).
Those are NOT declared here: an engagement is edited by a consultant in the web
app, where the change has an author and a review step. A model writing into the
system of record has neither.
ADR 0007 is resolved. The pilot restriction to demo or anonymised engagements
existed because the tool ran on a personal Claude account; it now runs on dentsu
Claude Enterprise. The ADR itself still says otherwise and should be updated to
record the migration — see docs/handover-offering-and-questionnaire.md § 7.
